title: Lebanon, MO - London Calling Pasty Food Truck at Pricecutter
seo_title: London Calling Pasty Food Truck in Lebanon, MO
description: London Calling Pasty Food Truck serves hand-held British pasties made from scratch, along with a frozen Take & Bake menu to heat at home in the oven at 350° for 45 minutes. The food truck is open to the public, and this month's special is a turkey and cranberry pasty. It will be parked at PriceCutter, 550 N Jefferson Ave in Lebanon, MO on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, from 11am to 7pm.
